name: FastX Network Token
description: FastX Network is a decentralized AI infrastructure. It is designed to empower Web3 applications through artificial intelligence. The project team has established global AI compute data centers and built a powerful data platform that unifies and orchestrates distributed computing resources, providing optimized support for its ecosystem projects. Community members can contribute to the infrastructure through holding mining nodes for mining power. FastX Network has closed its investment round in Nov 2025, backed by some of the top VCs in the industry, such as IBC, Castrum Capital, TBV, Gemhead, and Alpha Capital, etc.
